metadata.name: OpenBEXI Timeline — namespaces, access and UI models
metadata.purpose: HBDS design derived from source_template.yml and model_template.json, including canvas, band and zone background images.

timeline.status: Generic HBDS definition. Runtime instances use HBDS/schema/configuration.schema.json; editor writes require system administration. Namespace grants remain an explicit domain policy, separate from legacy API authorization.
timeline.cardinalityNotation: source = sources per target; target = targets per source. Composition means ownership, not class inheritance. Cardinalities are application constraints.
timeline.attributeNotation: Each attribute includes its complete JSON Schema under extensions.timeline.jsonSchema, including nested properties, choices and defaults. required and nullable are distinct.

meanings.admin: Read/write namespace data and manage that namespace configuration and grants.
meanings.rw: Read/write namespace records; no access-management permission.
meanings.r: Read namespace records and configuration needed to display them.

accessPolicy.effectivePermission: The lesser of Role.ceiling and the unique GroupNamespaceAccess.permission for User.groupId and the namespace; missing grant is denied.
accessPolicy.administratorFlag: User.admin enables global user/group administration only with Role.ceiling=admin. It does not bypass a missing or denied namespace grant.
accessPolicy.conflictPolicy: Duplicate group+namespace grants are invalid, not merged. Unknown permissions fail closed. Explicit denied always denies.
accessPolicy.legacyPermission: Source.permission is preserved verbatim for YAML compatibility; neither blank nor unknown legacy strings create authorization grants.

invariants: Every User references exactly one existing Role and Group. GroupNamespaceAccess is unique by groupId and namespaceId.
Each Namespace references exactly one UI Model. A Model can serve multiple namespaces; every read/write request still checks the selected namespace grant.
Repeated data_sources entries share Namespace identity but retain independent Source configuration, order, output path, filename filters and styling.
Render and Filter each have exactly one composition owner: Namespace defaults or a Source override. Source overrides win field by field; omitted settings inherit defaults.
Source.data_path retains string/list/empty form. DataPath objects are the ordered nonempty normalized paths. Namespace paths are derived, not separately edited.
An empty path list is valid for import-only json_file/local sources. S3 and Oracle may have empty data_path because bucket/query settings define their inputs.
data_model is the materialized output path pattern of a Source. It is distinct from UI Model.path and AISettings.model.
connector retains its legacy string/list form; protocol:port tokens separated by | map to Connector objects. Ingestion connections are provider settings.
SFTPSettings, S3Settings and OracleSettings exist only for the corresponding Source.type. local/json_file need no provider settings object.
Namespace Filter.include/exclude selects input files; Band.filter.field/equals selects displayed records.
Calendar and numeric-axis alternatives follow the existing UI schema; never combine NUMERIC ticks with calendar-only settings.
Background images are optional same-origin URL strings. Scene image, Band.backgroundImage and ZoneRender.backgroundImage keep their existing scopes and null defaults.
Preserve environment placeholders; never add actual credentials, ownership fields or access-control fields to existing event/session payloads.

accessResults.reason: No grant; admin flag does not bypass namespace permissions.

class.name: User
class.description: One role and one group per user. admin is the requested administrator flag, formerly written adman.

class.name: Role
class.description: A role limits the maximum namespace permission available through the user's group.

class.name: Group
class.description: Users share a group; permissions are assigned for each namespace through GroupNamespaceAccess.

class.name: GroupNamespaceAccess
class.description: Unique groupId + namespaceId. No assignment means denied. Explicit denied cannot be bypassed by User.admin.

class.name: Namespace
class.description: Logical namespace shared by repeated source entries. Owns default Render and Filter objects and selects one UI Model.

class.name: Source
class.description: One ordered YAML data_sources entry. Repeated namespaces retain separate settings and credentials references. Defaults on Namespace can be overridden per source.

class.name: Render
class.description: Nested namespace/source styling. A source override belongs only to that source, preserving per-entry colors.

class.name: Filter
class.description: Nested filename filter. include/exclude each preserve string or list form; this is distinct from a UI band record filter.

class.name: Connector
class.description: Timeline serving endpoint, distinct from ingestion connections. Legacy protocol:port tokens are split at | for the association.

class.name: TimelineTab
class.description: Ordered timeline tab. Selects a namespace; the UI model resolves through that namespace.

class.name: DataPath
class.description: Normalized nonempty source path, with order retained. Empty data_path lists create no path objects; the original form remains on Source.

class.name: SFTPSettings
class.description: Settings for type=sftp only. Environment placeholders are retained; password is optional when using a key.
